stem: A netball player in Colombo scored a mean of 14 goals per match over her first 6 matches of a season. After her 7th match, her mean for all 7 matches was 6 less than the number of goals she scored in the 7th match. How many goals did she score in the 7th match?
solution: Her first 6 matches total \(6 \cdot 14 = 84\) goals. Let \(g\) be her goals in the 7th match.
The new mean is \(\frac{84 + g}{7}\), and it equals \(g - 6\): \(84 + g = 7(g - 6)\).
So \(84 + g = 7g - 42\), \(126 = 6g\), and \(g = 21\). (Check: the new mean is 15.)
verify:
g = symbols('g')
sol = solve(Eq((6*14 + g)/7, g - 6), g)
assert sol == [21]
assert (84 + 21)/Integer(7) == 15
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == sol
